What does the NOvA experiment at Fermilab study?

NOvA studies neutrino oscillations - the quantum-mechanical behavior in which neutrinos change from one type to another as they travel. It helps determine the role neutrinos played in the evolution of the cosmos.

What quantity did the SeaQuest experiment measure with the Drell-Yan process?
SeaQuest measured the flavor asymmetry of the light-quark sea of the proton, using the proton-induced Drell-Yan process to compare anti-down and anti-up quark distributions.
